//order: Array order is precedence. First match wins.
//fields: dirs: matches any path segment. files: matches a whole filename, trailing * allowed. exts: matches the end of a filename, dot implied. not: names other kinds — the rule is skipped if any of them match first. All matching is case-insensitive.

rules.desc: Storybook / CSF files. Component demos consumed by a docs pipeline rather than run directly.
Bulk read-only input: datasets, eval sets, generated dumps. Fed to benches and evals, never asserted against. Above fixture so a corpus nested in fixtures/ still reads as corpus.
Small hand-authored inputs, mocks, and snapshots that a test asserts against. Above test so fixtures under __tests__/ don't get counted as tests.
Performance benchmarks. Runnable like a test but produces numbers, not pass/fail.
Example entrypoints meant to be read and run by hand.
Task entrypoints: build steps, codegen, CLIs.
Project and tool configuration. Above data so package.json doesn't read as data.
Type-only declarations. Above source so .d.ts doesn't get swallowed by the catch-all.
Structured data that isn't a manifest, fixture, or corpus. Loose config-ish files and tables.
Pure implementation code. Every ts/tsx file that isn't one of the kinds listed in `not` — so it stays pure no matter where this entry sits in the array.

//groups: Groups live in filePartitions.ts, not here — they need `as const` literal types to drive the generic return type, which a JSON import can't carry.

ignore.//: Directories are pruned before descent, so their contents are never read.
ignore.//dotdirs: Every dotdir and dotfile is skipped unconditionally, so .claude, .git, .next, .turbo, .venv, .cache and friends need no entry here. That sweep also drops .github and .env.
